# PR #3361: Patch: Terminus cards end the world: a set piece and a picture of its own for each Terminus card, Olivian Expanse and Ceaseless Void, and Dice of Doom's d100 rolled on screen

Closes #3338

## What changed

Each of the nine Terminus cards now has its own set piece and its own picture: Olivian Expanse, its six tokens (Farewell, KY's Last Exam, Event Horizon, Last Word, 1v1 Final Destination, The Big Crunch), Ceaseless Void and Dice of Doom. The change is all on the client (rule 7). No Rust crate is touched.

- **Two kinds of moment.** Each set piece's spec in `fx/setPieces.ts` now names the moment it plays over:
  - **Board clears.** Farewell and Ceaseless Void play over their removals, as R2800000's wipes do. The Void's fold now pulls each permanent into its chest in turn, as its `exiled` events come, and ends on its 10/10 burning. Farewell's lamp lifts each card it exiles, including graveyard cards as card backs, into its light.
  - **Signatures.** Every other card plays over a run of its hook's events of the types it names. The run is found by `game/runs.ts` `signatureRunAt` (or the card's first cast, for The Big Crunch) and becomes one pinned entry (`SIGNATURE_RUN_MS`) that `signatureClaim` holds as R2785000 holds every set piece.
  - `hasSetPiece` now answers true for board clears only, so the new keys never turn their removals into wipes.
- **Takeover.** A Mythic's takeover gives way to its own signature, as it already did to its own wipe. An entry whose entrance gave way can still be claimed, so a Terminus Trap's reveal and its set piece are one entry with one hold.
- **The planners** are in `fx/terminus/`, one per card, wired into `planFx`. The two cards that owe a turn draw what follows from the stream's memory (`memory.ts` `opening`/`openPlay`): Event Horizon snaps the board back and Last Word shows a Charge glow and a 3-2-1 countdown. While The Big Crunch's play resolves, its point stands over each of its entries.
- **Dice of Doom.** Its roll shows as a big d100 (`data-look="doom"`) landing on the public `rolled` faces. A 67 rains card backs into the hand, a miss crumbles the die, and a die rolled more than once (Lucky) keeps a gold glint. Whether it hit is read off what the run did (cards added or burned), never off the face, so the client restates no card number.
- **Hidden cards (R202).** No cue names a definition. A card added to a hand the seat can't read flies there as a card back.
- **Reduced motion and Big moments.** Reduce Motion shows one still frame (`data-still`, `FX_TERMINUS_STILL_MS`). Big moments "short" plays the short hold and "off" plays it unheld. Every hold is capped at `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS`.
- **Sound.** There is a new synthesized `organ` sound. Each Terminus bed opens on its own organ chord and closes on the Mythic choir.
- **Pictures.**
  - `TERMINUS_KINDS` gives the eight Stinkyscape cards eight new painters, found by id (Dice of Doom has no Terminus tag).
  - Ceaseless Void gets a `"void"` composition, a giant-shaped hole (`compositionOf`, `voidGiant`).
  - Radiant faces use the set's existing gilding. R503's fixtures are re-recorded for the nine cards.
- **Gem drain.** Ceaseless Void's cost gem drains as its cost falls, in its owner's own hand only (`cards/gemDrain.ts`).
- **Paperwork.**
  - Rulings R3338000 (set pieces), R3338001 (pictures) and R3338002 (gem drain), with their three paragraphs in `spec/pending/3338.md`.
  - One §10.10 sentence, and an amending sentence each in R2800000 and R2797000.
  - Updates to ART.md and `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md`.
  - The `--visual` fragment `crates/cards/patches/pending/terminus-cards-end-the-world-a-set-piece-and-a-picture-of.json`, with its notes and player lines filled in.

## How I tested it

This run finished the paperwork, fixed two test problems and ran every check myself:
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component`: both exit 0. The first attempt failed only because the wasm package hadn't been built yet. A readonly-array error in `terminus.test.ts` is fixed.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on every changed `.ts`/`.tsx` under `apps/web` and `e2e`: exit 0.
- The harness's web command (`vitest run --project web --changed origin/main`, fx and audio excluded): 356 of 357 files passed at first. The failure was `TerminusBoard.test.tsx` "R3338000 short and off", which timed out at 8.2 s under load because one `it` played 18 boards. I split it, and the reduced-motion loop, into one `it.each` test per card and setting. That's 36 tests, each under 0.5 s, all passing, with no timeout raised.
- `vitest run src/fx src/audio`, which the harness skips: 82 files, 1704 passed. The 5 skips are already on main; this diff adds no `.skip`, `.only` or suppression.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: ok (1795 rulings).
- `cargo jackioh patches check`: ok, after shortening one player line it refused for being over 200 characters.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: "Cards, micro, how cards look changed", no problems. classify reads fragments from git and the fragment isn't committed yet, so I ran it with `--head` on a throwaway commit object built from a temporary index. HEAD, the branch and the real index are untouched.
- Cypress:
  - `fx-terminus.cy.tsx` passes 22/22: every key plus Dice of Doom's miss and Embiggened, at 1280x720 and 390x844.
  - `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx` passes 7/7, including "R3338000 Ceaseless Void holds the phone frame budget" and "R3338000 Dice of Doom's 67 holds the phone frame budget".
  - I looked at the Dice of Doom (390x844) and Final Destination (1280x720) screenshots.
- `cargo fmt --check`: clean. I didn't run clippy or the cargo tests, since no Rust changed.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Seven stars, not six.** Since R1837000 added Ceaseless Void, the Discover pool is seven cards, so the rift circles `TERMINUS_IDS` (all seven). I rejected the issue's literal six.
- **Last Word's moment also takes `enteredGraveyard`.** In the real event stream, its run is `trapFired`, `enteredGraveyard`, then `modifierChanged`×3. The turn it owes is keyed to the resolving hook's controller, not the modifier's player: one of the modifiers is the opponent's.
- **Last Word's countdown burns out inside its turn-start entry.** One that stood through the whole turn would outlast its entry (R200).
- **Dice of Doom's end-of-turn `send` motif is dropped**, because a `{ setPiece }` table entry holds nothing else.
- **The Big Crunch's point starts after its first cast** and is drawn per entry, never as one cue standing for the whole play (R200).
- **The Echo glyph stamps over the chalked problem**, because the resolving Spell has nothing on the board to anchor it to.
- **The pull cue gained `travelMs` as well as `staggerMs`**, so each staggered card arrives in its own slice of the hold.
- **The old `set-piece-sink` keyframes are removed.** The fold now pulls cards to its centre instead of sinking them where they stood.
- **More fixtures re-recorded than planned.** Ceaseless Void's hashes are re-recorded in `core-art-v0.1.json` and `art-before-2724.json` as well as the Stinkyscape fixture. The Board snapshot is re-recorded too, since the Void sits on `fullBoardView`. Each test's comment cites R3338001.
- **The gem drains only in its owner's own hand**, not on the board or in a revealed hand. I rejected draining it everywhere.
- **Colour hex values in `fx.css`.** The doom die uses a few raw hex colours. Main's `fx.css` already has 35 of them, and `palette.test.ts` and `fx/css.test.ts` pass.

## Needs a person

- **Re-scoring the rendered intros.** Four cards' intros are not in the Terminus organ-and-choir family: `core-100`, `stinkyscape-004`, `stinkyscape-004-2` and `stinkyscape-154`. Re-scoring them needs FluidSynth, ffmpeg and a SoundFont for `gen:music`, which this machine doesn't have. Each card's sting is in its set-piece bed instead, and the `.m4a` files are untouched.

## Worth a second look

- `game/animations.ts` `setPieceEntries`: the takeover now gives way to a signature as well as to a wipe. `animations.wipe.test.ts` and `wipe.real.test.ts` still pass.
- `fx/terminus/doom.ts` and `rift.ts`, for R202: they never read an `addedToHand` `defId`. `terminus.test.ts` checks both from the opponent's seat.
- R3338001 leaves holding these pictures to their rarity's floor to #3331, and the recipes move to #3332's table form once that lands.

Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

Part of #3330. The owner asked that Terminus cards have crazy animations. They are the game's end-of-the-world cards and should feel it.

### Today

- **The cards.** Terminus cards are the six tokens Olivian Expanse (`stinkyscape-004`, Mythic) Discovers, printed Mythic, all cost 4, plus Ceaseless Void (`core-100`, Mythic), which carries the tag. Dice of Doom (`stinkyscape-154`, Mythic) adds every one of them at (0) on a roll of 67.
- **Art.** One shared black hole (`terminus()` in `stinkyscape.ts`) draws every Terminus token and Olivian Expanse. Ceaseless Void is the procedural painter's generic silhouette.
- **Animations now:**

| Card | Now |
|---|---|
| Olivian Expanse | bespoke `terminusRift` |
| Ceaseless Void | set piece `voidFold`, its own takeover look |
| `004-1` Farewell | the shared `vortex` set piece |
| `004-2` KY's Last Exam | `bolt` |
| `004-3` Event Horizon | none |
| `004-4` Last Word | `snap` |
| `004-5` 1v1 Final Destination | `bind` |
| `004-6` The Big Crunch | none (its Calls to Chaos play) |

### What it should be

Each card gets a picture of its own (base and Radiant, in its set's style) and a signature set piece. Every set piece fits one hold within `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS`, a tap skips it, and `bigMoments` and reduced motion still it as #3332 rules.
